part: P5A Part 20 -- Watchtower HOT/COLD Query Parity
objective: Verify every WATCHTOWER-attributed transfer_index row is queryable and produces identical results via the P5A build as via production.
watchtower_entity_source: database/wt_ops_v2.db operator_entities JOIN operators ON operator_id WHERE operators.display_name='WATCHTOWER'
method: For all 69 WATCHTOWER entity_addresses, queried every transfer_index row where the address appears as source OR destination, against production (id<=high_water) and the P5A unified HOT+COLD build (replacement_main.db + all 41 cold segments, deduped by signature+source+destination). Full row-set diff (signature, source, destination, amount_lamports, block_time tuples), not just counts.
note: All 274 WATCHTOWER-attributed transfer_index rows (across all 69 known entity addresses) are present and identical in the P5A HOT+COLD build. Zero rows lost, zero rows added.
